items.title: Ship Production Code 2x Faster With AI
items.author: DataTalksClub ⬛
items.summary:
In this video, we explore how to accelerate software delivery using structured AI development frameworks, moving past basic vibe coding to examine the exact systems engineering teams use to build and deploy reliable, production-grade features.

We are joined by special guest Mihail Eric, former technical lead for Amazon Alexa's early LLMs and co-founder of multiple AI software engineering initiatives. Mihail breaks down his proven RAPID framework, teaching you how to onboard onto legacy codebases, eliminate agent scope creep, and orchestrate concurrent agent teams without sacrificing code quality.

TIMECODES:
00:00 DevOps Automation Guardrails for Infrastructure Coding Agents
05:16 RAPID AI Software Development Framework Tutorial
11:02 Legacy Code Onboarding with AI Cursor Tools
15:42 System Architecture Analysis for LLM Feature Planning
21:24 Building SQLite Full Text Search Systems with LLMs

33:20 Solution Generation and LLM Divergence Prompting
38:26 Eliminating AI Agent Scope Creep via PRD Templates
